mapper.insert: insert into source.source_endpoint ( id, source_entity_id, name, url, normalized_url, endpoint_type, connector_type, language, polling_interval_seconds, display_policy, index_policy, authority_override, config, credential_ref, status, health_status, failure_count, version, created_by, catalog_kind, catalog_key ) values ( #{id}, #{sourceEntityId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{normalizedUrl}, #{endpointType}, #{connectorType}, #{language}, #{pollingIntervalSeconds}, #{displayPolicy}, #{indexPolicy}, #{authorityOverride}, cast(#{configJson} as jsonb), #{credentialRef}, #{status}, #{healthStatus}, #{failureCount}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{catalogKind}, #{catalogKey} )

insert into source.source_endpoint ( id, source_entity_id, name, url, normalized_url, endpoint_type, connector_type, language, polling_interval_seconds, display_policy, index_policy, authority_override, config, credential_ref, status, health_status, failure_count, version, created_by, catalog_kind, catalog_key, next_fetch_at ) values ( #{id}, #{sourceEntityId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{normalizedUrl}, #{endpointType}, #{connectorType}, #{language}, #{pollingIntervalSeconds}, #{displayPolicy}, #{indexPolicy}, #{authorityOverride}, cast(#{configJson} as jsonb), #{credentialRef}, #{status}, #{healthStatus}, #{failureCount}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{catalogKind}, #{catalogKey}, case when #{status} = 'ACTIVE' then now() else null end ) on conflict (catalog_key) where catalog_key is not null do update set source_entity_id = excluded.source_entity_id, name = excluded.name, url = excluded.url, normalized_url = excluded.normalized_url, endpoint_type = excluded.endpoint_type, connector_type = excluded.connector_type, language = excluded.language, polling_interval_seconds = excluded.polling_interval_seconds, display_policy = excluded.display_policy, index_policy = excluded.index_policy, config = excluded.config, status = excluded.status, next_fetch_at = case when excluded.status = 'ACTIVE' and ( source_endpoint.status <> 'ACTIVE' or source_endpoint.url is distinct from excluded.url or source_endpoint.connector_type is distinct from excluded.connector_type or source_endpoint.config is distinct from excluded.config ) then now() when excluded.status = 'ACTIVE' then source_endpoint.next_fetch_at else null end, version = source_endpoint.version + 1, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select id::text from source.source_entity where slug = #{slug}

select id, source_entity_id, name, url, normalized_url, endpoint_type, connector_type, language, polling_interval_seconds, display_policy, index_policy, authority_override, config::text as config_json, credential_ref, status, health_status, last_success_at, last_failure_at, failure_count, last_probe_status, last_probe_latency_ms, version, created_by, catalog_kind, catalog_key, created_at, updated_at from source.source_endpoint where id = #{id}

select s.id, s.name, s.slug, s.entity_type, s.official_level, s.authority_score, s.status as source_status, e.id as endpoint_id, e.name as endpoint_name, e.endpoint_type, e.connector_type, e.url as endpoint_url, e.status as endpoint_status, e.catalog_kind, e.health_status, e.last_success_at, e.last_failure_at, e.version as endpoint_version, e.last_fetch_item_count, (select count(*) from content.content_item c where c.endpoint_id = e.id and c.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai') at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai') as today_content_count, e.updated_at from source.source_entity s join source.source_endpoint e on e.source_entity_id = s.id where s.id = #{sourceId} order by e.updated_at desc, e.id desc

select count(*) filter (where catalog_kind <> 'TEST') as total_endpoints, count(*) filter (where catalog_kind <> 'TEST' and status = 'ACTIVE') as active_endpoints, count(*) filter (where catalog_kind <> 'TEST' and health_status = 'HEALTHY') as healthy_endpoints, count(*) filter (where catalog_kind <> 'TEST' and health_status in ('WARNING', 'FAILED')) as attention_endpoints, count(*) filter (where catalog_kind = 'PRODUCTION') as production_endpoints, count(*) filter (where catalog_kind = 'TEST') as test_endpoints from source.source_endpoint where status <> 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.update: update source.source_entity set status = 'ACTIVE', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'DRAFT'

update source.source_endpoint set health_status = #{healthStatus}, last_probe_status = #{httpStatus}, last_probe_latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, last_success_at = case when #{successful} then now() else last_success_at end, last_failure_at = case when #{successful} then last_failure_at else now() end, failure_count = case when #{successful} then 0 else failure_count + 1 end, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
